items.title: Micron Stock Closes Above $1,000. Why It’s Not What It Seems.
items.summary: Investors on Friday pushed shares of  Micron Technology  to close above $1,000 for the first time since mid-August, following the release of OpenAI’s latest artificial-intelligence model and as the AI-trade picked up momentum.  Micron stock advanced 6.1% to $1,016.59 on Friday, marking the first time shares have closed above $1,000 since Aug. 17, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Among other memory companies, American depositary receipts of  SK Hynix  were up 8.1%.
